{Funding Alert} Consumer Electronics Brand EDT Raises Funding Ahead of Festive Season

Mumbai-based consumer technology brand EDT has secured $2.4 million in a Pre-Series A funding round led by existing investor Sauce, with participation from its current angel investors.

The funding round also attracted investments from Alteria Capital, Raul Rai of Nicobar, Shibam Das and Arindam Paul of Atomberg, Ajith Pai of Delhivery, and Anushree Tainwala of Samsonite.

The company plans to deploy the fresh capital toward inventory creation ahead of the festive shopping season, introduction of new products, and strengthening its growth, supply chain, branding, and product development teams. [...] > “Banana chips have often been underrated due to lack of innovation and right technology, but in reality , they are one of the most delightful snacks out there. Hence we decided to drive that innovation and bring the latest technology in banana chips. Our banana chips redefine the snacking experience—delicately thin, irresistibly crispy, and bursting with bold, mouthwatering flavors. They’re more than just a snack; they’re a treat for the senses. This new investment empowers us to bring the unique taste of Beyond Snack banana chips to even more snack enthusiasts across the country, elevating their snacking moments to a whole new level,” shared Manas Madhu, Founder, Beyond Snack. [...] > Jain said, “Over these years, I built Hong Kong and Taiwan into a top 10 market, returned to India and turned around the business, and strengthened the Dyson into a brand that every customer aspired to own, and every business desired to build. Time to build something new. More soon.”

With its planned entry into the kitchen appliances segment, Foundry will compete in a market that has attracted several emerging consumer brands. These include Nester, Nuuk, Atomberg, Geek Technology and Wonderchef, which are focusing on product innovation and contemporary designs to compete with established players such as Havells and Usha.
